e.title: Open-Meteo（免费天气 API）
e.summary: 开源免费天气预报/历史天气 API（6127★）：天气衍生品、农业指数保险、巨灾建模的气象数据底座
e.body: Open-Meteo（open-meteo/open-meteo，6127★，Swift，2026-09 活跃）是免费开源天气 API：提供预报、历史天气、气象再分析（ERA5 等）与空气质量数据——非商业免费、无密钥起步，广泛用于天气衍生品、农业指数保险与能源/巨灾场景。对 RIAA：天气指数保险与气象风险的『数据即服务』底座——补上精算建模需要的气象时间序列（与 [[cds]]（ERA5 官方气候数据存储）、[[ml-drought]] 气象 ML 互补）；理解天气 API 生态（Open-Meteo vs 商业 IBM/AccuWeather）是农业/参数保险产品设计的第一步。
e.verified_note: raw GitHub 核实：Open-Meteo 免费天气 API（6127★，预报+历史+再分析）
e.summary_en: Open-source free weather forecast/history API (6127★): the meteorological data foundation for weather derivatives, index agriculture insurance and cat modelling
e.summary_hk: 開源免費天氣預報/歷史天氣 API（6127★）：天氣衍生品、農業指數保險、巨災建模的氣象數據底座
e.body_en: Open-Meteo (open-meteo/open-meteo, 6127★, Swift, active 2026-09) is a free open-source weather API: forecasts, historical weather, meteorological reanalysis (ERA5 and more) and air quality — free for non-commercial use, usable without a key, widely used for weather derivatives, agricultural index insurance and energy/catastrophe use cases. For RIAA: a 'data-as-a-service' foundation for weather index insurance and meteorological risk — supplying the weather time series that actuarial modelling needs (complements [[cds]] (the official ERA5 climate data store) and [[ml-drought]] meteorological ML); understanding the weather-API landscape (Open-Meteo vs commercial IBM/AccuWeather) is the first step in agriculture/parametric insurance product design.
e.body_hk: Open-Meteo（open-meteo/open-meteo，6127★，Swift，2026-09 活躍）是免費開源天氣 API：提供預報、歷史天氣、氣象再分析（ERA5 等）與空氣質量數據——非商業免費、無密鑰起步，廣泛用於天氣衍生品、農業指數保險與能源/巨災場景。對 RIAA：天氣指數保險與氣象風險的『數據即服務』底座——補上精算建模需要的氣象時間序列（與 [[cds]]（ERA5 官方氣候數據存儲）、[[ml-drought]] 氣象 ML 互補）；理解天氣 API 生態（Open-Meteo vs 商業 IBM/AccuWeather）是農業/參數保險產品設計的第一步。
